tagline: 柯达盒式相机，1907 年发布
description: 柯达于1907年推出的盒式相机。配备Single element, meniscus。快门速度Rotary type, Time and Instant (most likely 1/25th to 1/30th)。使用116 film。

specs.快门速度: Rotary type, Time and Instant (most likely 1/25th to 1/30th)
specs.光圈: Three stops, f/8, f/11 and f/16.
specs.取景器: Two reflected window types, horizontal and vertical
